name: Style Theory
description: Hello Internet! Welcome to STYLE THEORY, where beauty is a science. Suit up and come along as we answer fashion’s most important questions: Is your makeup poisonous? Could a high heel actually kill someone? And how do the Hulk’s pants even stay on? Our closet is FULL of theories, so prepare to explore the world of style, trends, and fashion in a whole new way! Subscribe, because the best way to look is smart.

videos.title: The Great Pocket Conspiracy!
videos.overview: Have you ever wondered why your pockets are SO small, Loyal Theorist? If not, then you're probably a dude. You see, women’s pockets are notoriously known for being tiny and useless. But WHY are they so small? This is a conspiracy that goes deep! So watch to find out who killed women’s pockets.

videos.title: The Secret to Hulk’s Pants is… Spider-Man?!
videos.overview: We all know how HULK can transform from human to giant green monster in the course of seconds (hint: it’s gamma radiation). But, what's the secret to his pants transforming like they do? She-Hulk explains this away as just “spandex,” but there’s NO way that I’m buying that! This is what I think his pants are really made of…

videos.title: These Shoes can KILL!
videos.overview: You’ve heard the term “killer heels,” right? Like “these heels are KILLING my feet.” But that got me thinking... Could a high heel ACTUALLY be used as a weapon? Today we’re slinging stilettos as we put the question to the test!

videos.title: The TOXIC Truth About Your Makeup
videos.overview: You should be SCARED, Loyal Theorist. Why? Well, your makeup is POISONING you! That’s right. Take a second look at your foundation, mascara, lipstick, and other beauty products because it’s totally toxic. Here’s why you may want to throw away all it…

videos.title: Can Math Make You MORE Beautiful?
videos.overview: Take a selfie of your face. Now flip the photo. Something looks off doesn’t it? That’s because the symmetry in your face may not be perfect. And neither is mine! But what does it take to make the perfect face? And are some faces inherently better looking than others?! Start watching to find out if math can make you more beautiful.

videos.title: Are School Uniforms Worth It?
videos.overview: Maybe you’ve heard that school uniforms make you smarter. Dress for success, right? WRONG! Schools have been lying to you about school uniforms, and we’re going to expose the truth. Watch to find out whether school uniforms actually work or if they’re just a ruse.

videos.title: Can You Be Allergic to Color? (Wednesday Addams)
videos.overview: According to Wednesday Addams, her skin breaks into hives and flesh peels off her bones when she even TOUCHES Color. Wait a minute… is that real? Can you actually be ALLERGIC to color? Let’s find out…

videos.title: Why Are People Wearing this STUPID Hat?
videos.overview: If you’ve been to any sporting event recently, chances are you’ve seen fans wearing some SILLY hats. You know what we’re talking about, right? Those oversized foam ball caps aren’t a joke, though; in fact, they’re the NEXT big fashion trend. It’s no wonder the likes of Josh Allen, Brian Robinson, and Ludacris are all wearing these things. But why? Let’s talk about it…

videos.title: Do You WASH Your Legs?
videos.overview: Do you wash your legs? Yes, that’s a legitimate question. And prepare to be shocked because there are more people who DON’T wash their legs than you’d realize. Their reasoning is that GRAVITY takes care of the wash. So are the non-washers saving time in the shower or are they just extremely dirty? Let’s turn on the hot water and find out.

videos.title: SHEIN is Stealing… and it’s Legal?!
videos.overview: SHEIN. You’ve seen the mega brand. Maybe you’ve even worn it? But did you know they are complete and utter THIEVES? More than once they’ve stolen designs from smaller creators such as Blogilates. But do you want to know the crazy part? It’s actually LEGAL! Watch to hear full story.

videos.title: You’ll NEVER Get Dressed Again!
videos.overview: Okay, HOW on Earth is this dress possible? Seriously, a spray-on dress?! This thing defies all logic and physics. Yet Bella Hadid wore a spray-on dress during Paris Fashion Week and turned everyone’s head. So let’s learn the science of how this impossible clothing is actually possible.

videos.title: TikTok's Color Test is TRASH!
videos.overview: Welcome to the first episode of Style Theory Basics! Today we’re covering the foundations of color theory and how YOU can use it to your advantage. Don’t trust a TikTok filter to do the work; trust us, there’s a better way!

videos.title: The Color of EVIL! (Puss in Boots)
videos.overview: Think of your all-time favorite villain. Is it the Joker? Thanos? Big Jack Horner? Whoever it is we guarantee they’re wearing purple. But why? WHY do the most iconic villains wear the same color? Does wearing a deep violet automatically make you EVIL? Or is there something else we’re missing?

videos.title: STOP Washing Your Clothes Like This! (Tide)
videos.overview: You’re washing your clothes WRONG! As a matter of fact, Loyal Theorist, you may be making your clothes even dirtier (and bluer) by throwing them in a washing machine. If you’re looking for house hacks or cleaning hacks for your latest load of laundry, we’re happy to help. But there is a secret that Tide, All, and Persil are NOT telling you. Be warned because after watching this episode you may want to burn your entire wardrobe! Or at the very least, you’ll learn how to do laundry the RIGHT way and not harm yourself in the process.

videos.title: Can You ACTUALLY Eat the Lady Gaga Meat Dress?
videos.overview: Welcome to MEAT WEEK, Loyal Theorists! Before you check out our other meat-themed content on our other channels, Game Theory, Film Theory, and Food Theory, we just HAVE to talk about the weirdest fashion trend around meat: that is, Lady Gaga’s meat dress. She wore the mutton chops at the 2010 MTV Video Music Awards (VMAs) and her attire made its way around the internet, so much so, that we’re talking about it 13 years later! But why? Well, in honor of Meat Week, we’re wondering whether you can actually EAT the dress and how many calories you would intake if you did consume it all. So grab a knife, and let’s dig in!

videos.title: The Cult of Taylor Swift
videos.overview: Are you a “Swiftie,” Loyal Theorist? If so then there’s a good chance you saw Taylor Swift perform live during her Eras Tour… that is, if you could get tickets to it. She has a setlist consisting of her best hits: 22, Look What You Made Me Do, Anti Hero, You Belong With Me, Shake It Off, and 40 other songs. It is over THREE HOURS! Trust us, it was a STELLAR setlist that gave a glimpse into every Taylor Swift era. But it got the Theorist gears turning. Why is Tay-Tay flipping between looks faster than we can say 1.. 2… 3… Let’s go Swift!

videos.title: Your Clothes Can Predict the FUTURE!
videos.overview: Hey Theorists, how short are your pants? Are they as short as Pedro Pascal’s shorts at the 2023 Met Gala? Or as long as Rihanna’s flowing Valentino Haute Couture gown? Well take a good look because your answer may determine whether we’re actually in an economic recession or time of prosperity. But, wait… how is that possible? Your shorts can’t ACTUALLY predict the future, can they? Hang on to those short shorts because we’re about to find out!

videos.title: School Dress Codes Will RUIN Your Life!
videos.overview: Dress codes kind of suck, don’t they? Sure, they allow us to express individuality and show off cute school outfits in grwm videos on YouTube. But, they also come with annoying rules that cause many students to get suspended! So with the last day of school approaching, we wanted to break down WHY dress codes don’t work. But more importantly we’ll figure out HOW dress codes are impacting society in a negative way.

videos.title: You Eat 9 POUNDS of Lipstick in Your Lifetime
videos.overview: If you’ve ever worn lipstick, lip gloss, or chapstick at some point in your life, then you know how difficult eating and drinking can be. Of course some of the application goes onto your food, but where does the rest go? That’s simple: into YOUR mouth. That’s right, you are EATING your lipstick every day. But, it can’t be that bad, right? WRONG. In fact, you may be ingesting more lipstick in your lifetime than you actually realize. So is it 6lbs? 9lbs? 20 lbs? Let’s find out…

videos.title: Don’t WASTE Your Money on Color Changing Clothes! (Viral TikTok)
videos.overview: We’ve all seen the “TikTok Made Me Buy It” and “Viral TikTok Products” videos, and as we know there are some WEIRD TikTok products. But some of the recent strangest are the ph5 color changing dress and Nike Air Force 1 uv activated shoes! Mia Maples, HopeScope, Izzipoopi, and other influencers have all given their SHOCKED reactions to the products. But today we want to ask how this MAGIC actually works and… is it even worth it?

videos.title: Color Seasons are a Complete LIE!
videos.overview: We have BIG news, Loyal Theorist! We conducted the world’s LARGEST color analysis in history just so we could prove the internet wrong. If you’ve explored the fashion and style vertical at all on YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok, then you’ve likely seen the thousands of color season tests. (Btw, are you a winter, summer, autumn, or spring?) But how LEGIT are these color analyses? And do they REALLY affect how others see you? Let’s find out…

videos.title: I Tested WEIRD TikTok Perfume! (Missing Person Perfume)
videos.overview: Have you ever taken a whiff of something and been immediately transported back in time? No, we’re not talking about time travel; we’re talking about nostalgia! Throwing ball with your dad, building blanket forts with mom, playing video games with friends. Well TikTok claims this new perfume (Phlur Missing Person) is meant to bring out ALL of the nostalgia. Not necessarily memories of childhood, but of someone you miss. But does this actually work? We tested the TikTok product to find out!

videos.title: Your Soap WON'T Get You Clean?!
videos.overview: In our previous shower episode we asked, “should you wash your legs in the shower.” And you Loyal Theorists loved it so much and asked so many follow-up questions that we HAD to make another episode. So, here we are asking the question, “which soap gets you cleanest?” We put four types of Dove soap to the test to learn the answer. But none of us were expecting the truth about the soap industry that actually came out…

videos.title: The Barbie Movie Made Me Question EVERYTHING! (No Spoilers)
videos.overview: Are high heels bad for you? Ladies, you may have wondered this age-old question at some point in your life. And with Margot Robbie’s Barbie movie coming out, we thought there was NO better time to answer it. Should you wear high heels or opt for flats like Birkenstocks? Today, we find out!

videos.title: Exposing the WORST Scam in Clothing History!
videos.overview: Women’s clothing sizes kind of… SUCK! Lady Theorists, if you’ve ever taken a trip to any clothing outfitter, then you know the agonizing struggle of finding the right size. You may be a size 6 at one store but a size 8 at the next. It’s a total mess. But why? Why is this the way women’s clothes are set up, and where did it all start? This is the Great Size Conspiracy!

videos.title: How to Finally Stop SHEIN!
videos.overview: SHEIN is back at it again, Loyal Theorists. If you remember from our previous episode we learned that the fast fashion brand STOLE from popular YouTuber Cassey Ho (Blogilates). But things just got WORSE. Not only did they steal from Cassey again, but they also got involved in a Rico lawsuit and earned BAD press from social media influencers. Can SHEIN survive this?

videos.title: What is the Ken Effect? (The Barbie Movie)
videos.overview: In 2023, Barbie is a fashion ICON. And that’s thanks in part to Margot Robbie rocking old-school Barbie outfits on the “pink” carpet of the Barbie Movie. But she’s not the only one in the spotlight; in fact, Ryan Gosling’s Ken is also getting his share of attention. Plus… so can you! That’s right, if you want in on the Barbie fashion trends, you can join in with Gap’s Barbie collection, Zara’s Ken boxers, Mumu’s Barbie Babe one piece, Crocs’ chonky pink shoes, and many more Barbie Movie themed clothes. Is Barbie starting a brand new fashion renaissance? Today, Loyal Theorist, we find out that the future if FULL of pink!

videos.title: I Wore Edible Underwear for 48 Hours!
videos.overview: Edible underwear… It sure is a thing! But is it edible? And is it underwear? Today MatPat wears it around for 48 hours to answer those exact questions. Find out if the undergarments can withstand a day of script writing, yard work, and the McDonald’s drive through. Or just stick around for the zaniness that took place throughout the day. Trust us, this is the WEIRDEST episode we’ve ever done!

videos.title: The Secret Style of The Rich!
videos.overview: Luxury is different for everyone. For some, it’s wearing expensive brands like Gucci, Supreme, and Rolex. For others it’s wearing a very high quality, subtle sweater that costs $1,000. The difference in perception is old money vs new money thinking. And trust us, Loyal Theorists, the way that you think about rich people is all WRONG!

videos.title: Sunscreen is a LIE?!
videos.overview: Does sunscreen actually work, Loyal Theorist? Recently TikTok has been filled with naysayers trash-talking sunscreen. And that got us to wonder: What is the difference between the different SPFs? Does the brand, such as Sun Bum or Banana Boat, change your tan? Are there any other products, such as mayonnaise or coconut oil that could perform better? It’s time to BURN, baby, BURN!

videos.title: Why is James Charles Selling PAINT? (Painted)
videos.overview: Something is stirring in the makeup world, Loyal Theorist. Yes, of course, it has to be James Charles! Everyone is canceling him for selling paint makeup. But we’re not here to talk about the James Charles controversy; instead we’re wondering WHY on earth he’s selling paint to consumers. Trust us, “Painted” isn’t all glitz and glam…

videos.title: You’re Shaving Your Face WRONG!
videos.overview: Today, loyal theorists, we’re learning how to shave your face. But, we’re not just grabbing a razor and having at it; no, we’re using 8 guys and 10 different blades to find the absolutely PERFECT way to shave. Which razor works best: five blade, safety razor, straight edge, electrical or something else? Lather up that shaving cream and get ready for some awesome grooming tips!

videos.title: This Shirt Can PROTECT Your Identity?!
videos.overview: Smile, you're being watched! It seems like we can't go anywhere nowadays without being captured by some kind of surveillance camera. Even simple trips can result in our facial data being recorded by TONS of different cameras. What if there was clothing that could prevent that, that would prevent you from being recognized and your face stored by AI? Well friends, let me tell you a little bit about Anti-Surveillance Clothing!

videos.title: Can Feng Shui Cure My Depression?
videos.overview: How calm are you, Loyal Theorist? Calm enough to tackle working a 9-5 job, taking out the garbage, mowing the lawn, cooking dinner, doing laundry, unloading the dishwasher, and EVERY other major chore? Well, if you’re feeling STRESSED out by everything in life, we have a solution for you: Feng Shui.

videos.title: I Wore 100 Years of Halloween Costumes
videos.overview: Boo! It’s SPOOKY season, Loyal Theorist, and that means it’s time to get in the SPIRIT of Halloween. Sure, we’ve already been munching on candy and watching fall movies like Hocus Pocus and The Nightmare Before Christmas. But, today… oh today… we’re dressing up in the most WICKED Halloween costumes from the past 100 years. Witches, ghouls, ghosts, and monsters BEWARE because what we found will make your blood curdle.

videos.title: You're Wearing Your Socks WRONG
videos.overview: Socks are great! They come in all different colors and sizes; there are long socks, short socks, fuzzy socks, dress socks… But the best part about socks, other than covering up those nasty feet, is that they keep us warm. But there are _some_ people out there who argue that wearing ONE sock is better than wearing two socks. There’s no way, right? Today, we put that theory to the test!

videos.title: How to SURVIVE Black Friday
I Made the World’s UGLIEST Christmas Sweater
You Don't Know How to Brush Your Teeth
Is TikTok Shop the Next Amazon?
videos.overview: Around Black Friday 2023, TikTok shut down THOUSANDS of small business shops on its platform without warning. Yes, those small TikTok businesses that SarahGrace, HopeScope, Mia Maples, and other creators love to buy from and make haul videos about every week... they're GONE! It sounds kind of shady and downright disturbing, right? But what if we told you TikTok just saved those small businesses MILLIONS of dollars? Here’s the lowdown on the TikTok Shop scandal…

videos.title: I Tried the 1,000 Layer Nail Polish Challenge
videos.overview: If you’re one of the 50 million people who watched the simplynailogical videos putting on 100+ coats of nail polish, then you know nails can get pretty out of control. Well, we decided to take the 100 layers challenge idea and kick it up a notch by trying to apply 1,000+ layers of nail polish to a hand. Can it be done? Can we make nail art pretty enough to go viral on TikTok? Will HopeScope end up reacting to this “satisfying” creation? And will we reach the top of #PolishMountain? Today, loyal Theorists, we find out in this ultimate nails challenge!

videos.title: Can Caffeine Beauty Products ENERGIZE You?
videos.overview: Are caffeine skincare products worth it? Like, do the serums, scrubs, and facemasks actually give you as much energy as, let’s say, a Diet Coke, Monster Energy, Red Bull, or even coffee? Are you actually absorbing that energy through your skin? We put our caffeine addictions to the side to first go caffeine free and then test a new skincare routine. Just like Mia Maples loves to do with viral TikTok products and HopeScope with satisfying viral products, we’re experimenting with a whole new routine that could change the way we take care of our skins… or it may just be a bunch of bunk!

videos.title: I Hired a $20 Stylist to Dress Me
videos.overview: After seeing the fun videos full of fashion inspo from Ellbat (I Hired a $200 Stylist and $20 Stylist to Dress Me for a Week) and Mia Maples (I Hired 3 Stylists with Different Aesthetics to Style Me), we’ve decided to test the world of online personal stylists for ourselves. Today we’re testing Fiverr vs Stich Fix to see if any of these digital personal stylists are worth it. What is the cost? Can Ai really determine what we should wear? And can we actually find a new look in this process? C’mon, get ready with us as we try on a whole new wardrobe!

videos.title: Skincare is a SCAM?!
videos.overview: Which skincare products do YOU use, loyal Theorist? Neutrogena? CeraVe? Cetaphil? Pond’s? Well, you may want to take a CLOSER look at the label. It turns out that the skincare industry may have been lying to us for years about what’s really hidden inside of their products. Sorry, Mia Maples, but you may think twice before doing about skincare test video because this could change your daily skincare routine FOREVER.

videos.title: MatPat’s Final Glow Up!
videos.overview: The countdown begins, loyal Theorists. This is MatPat’s FINAL Style Theory ever. We knew we had to go out with a BANG! So, we’re looking back at Matt’s time on Style Theory, what we’ve learned, and whether MatPat has _actually_ become a real style icon by putting him to the ultimate styling test. Grab yourself a bow tie and let’s suit up!

videos.title: You’re Shaving Your Legs WRONG!
videos.overview: Hello, loyal Theorists, and welcome to Amy’s FIRST Style Theory! Today we’re diving back into our favorite Style Theory setting: the bathroom. We’re testing the best ways to shave your legs with a fun experiment. Which is the best lubricant: shaving cream, soap, or something else? Is there a best brand to use, like Gillette? Well, by the end of this video, we promise that your legs will be perfectly silky smooth!

videos.title: I Shopped Like a BILLIONAIRE on Temu
videos.overview: If you watched the Super Bowl, then you saw a whole lot of Travis Kelce, incredible coverage on Taylor Swift, and a very questionable ad on Temu. You probably remember the ad well, right? Temu: shop like a billionaire. It played, like, 500 times throughout the game. But can you _actually_ shop like a BILLIONAIRE on Temu? If FaZe Rug, HopeScope, Mia Maples, and the hundreds of other YouTuber videos have shown us anything about the brand, the answer is a strong NO. But we had to find out for ourselves. Will we walk around looking like tech moguls Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, and Mark Cuban? Can we strut in a dress as expensive as Taylor Swift’s? Or will the Temu dupes make our space look like Kim Kardashian’s Sknn office decor with a bunch of Donald Judd dupes? C’mon, loyal Theorist, let’s shop like billionaires!

videos.title: What's Your Body Shape... and How to Dress for It
videos.overview: Have you ever thought, “why do I look bad in everything?” We promise, you DON’T! But one factor that could lead to you feeling that way is not dressing to your body shape or body type. So today we want to show you exactly how to find your body type. First we’re using various tests like Kibbe, Fruits, and Myers Briggs. AND then we’ll teach you how to dress no matter the shape of your body: rectangle, pear, or inverted triangle. Let us know your shape in the comments below!

videos.title: ﻿How to Keep Your Closet Clean FOREVER!
videos.overview: Is your closet a MESS, loyal Theorist? Are your clothes all thrown about with no rhyme or rhythm where they should be? Or maybe you have a system but you feel like your closet space is just _too_ small. Whatever size wardrobe you have, we want to help you clean up your mess. So we're following the footsteps of Mia Maples and decluttering YEARS worth of clothes. This is going to be one intense closet clean out!

videos.title: Why Does Gen Z Look SO Old?
videos.overview: Theorist, does Gen Z look older than other generations like Baby Boomers and Millennials? Everyone on the internet seems to think so thanks to TikToker Jordan Howlett. But is it even true? Well, we that know Gen Z celebs like Reneé Rapp, Millie Bobby Brown, and Kylie Jenner tend to look older than they look, so that's a start. So then... WHY is this the case? WHY is Gen Z aging so rapidly? Today we find out.

videos.title: We Created YouTube's First Fashion Show!
videos.overview: A few weeks ago we, together with our friends at ZHC, Critical Role, Seek Discomfort, and Popflex, put on YouTube's FIRST ever creator fashion show. The event was a total blast and we enjoyed hanging out with you on the live stream. But now... we want to show you behind the scenes of what it REALLY takes to put together a fashion show. Let's find out!

videos.title: Fallout’s Vault Suit Will Kill You! (Fallout)
videos.overview: You've been asking for months, loyal Theorist, and today we finally answer: which clothes would help you survive a nuclear apocalypse? With Fallout on Amazon Prime making waves in the cultural conversation, we knew we HAD to answer the question for you. Do we need super high-tech survival gear? Or can we just wear jeans and a t-shirt? Let's find out...

videos.title: Ai Could KILL Your Favorite Creator!
videos.overview: Your favorite influencer may be turning into Ai... No, we're not talking about Vtubers, we're talking about companies like Meta turning creators and influencers into Ai chatbots. From MrBeast to Kendall Jenner to Charli D'Amelio to Tom Brady, they've all signed some Ai rights over to Zuck. But what exactly are the Ai creators like Kwebbelkop, Lil Miquela, and others doing? How are they making money? And is ANY of this good for society? Today, Theorists, we talk about a very controversial topic...

videos.title: Does Waterproof Makeup ACTUALLY Work?
videos.overview: How _waterproof_ is waterproof makeup? A little? A lot? Can your foundation last a trip to the pool? Would your eyeliner hold up against the harsh waves at the beach? And could your mascara survive a night of crying? Today we're putting these brands to the test to find out how to make your makeup waterproof!

videos.title: The Mustache is Making a COMEBACK... But Why?
videos.overview: Guess what's making a comeback, loyal Theorists? The MUSTACHE! The handlebar, the chevron, the english, the pencil, even the fu manchu. They're BACK! Today we discover why they've resurged and whether you should start rocking a 'stache too.

videos.title: I Put Crocs to the ULTIMATE Test!
videos.overview: Are crocs truly the ultimate active footwear? After seeing @hopescope test out _every_ single Croc, from survival Crocs to Crocs ballet flats, we knew we had to try them out. Millennials started wearing Crocs as an everyday shoe, but Gen Z and Gen Alpha have taken it to the next level. Some members of Croc Nation, like Ash of @GTLive , are actually wearing Crocs to the gym! That's sport mode on a whole other level. Today we're going through a whole series of tests to see if Crocs can _really_ walk the walk.

videos.title: How Anime SECRETLY Took Over the World of Fashion
videos.overview: Hey, loyal Theorist, did you know that anime has SECRETLY been influencing the world of fashion for YEARS? Think about it: big red boots, giant bows, and unnatural hair color. What do they ALL have in common? A link back to anime. In this video we'll reveal the secret influences of Dragon Ball Z, Sailor Moon, and more on our culture.

videos.title: Temu Needs to STOP Stealing from Creators!
videos.overview: A few weeks ago, creator MiaMaples posted a video called "Temu Stole From Me," where she explained how the company took her name, image, and likeness to promote and sell a product. Sounds kind of familiar, right? If you've followed Style Theory over the past year, you'll remember our video about how SHEIN did something similar to Cassey Ho (@blogilates) of POPFLEX. If you follow @hopescope you may know she's posted multiple videos buying brands that stole her videos for ads. She was able to poke fun at the matter, whereas creators like Cassey, Mia, CassandraBankson, and simplynailogical all made more serious videos discussing the unfortunate topic. So what's the deal with these shady business practices from SHEIN and Temu? What happened and how do they keep getting away with it?

videos.title: The SECRET to Winning the Olympics is... Uniforms?!
videos.overview: The Olympics have been SO fun to watch, haven't they, Theorists? Watching Simone Biles soar to gold in women's gymnastics, Caeleb Dressel rake in the medals in men's swimming, the USA women's rugby team shocking the nation, and every other Olympic athlete has been an absolute thrill. But, one thing that we questioned was just how optimal their uniforms are. Is there a better way to win gold?

videos.title: I Found the Best and WORST Sunscreen for Your Skin
videos.overview: Summer is, unfortunately, winding down and school is about to be back in session. But that doesn't mean the sun is taking a break. In fact, it's warmer than ever here in California. So Amy wanted to find out: what is the BEST and WORST sunscreen to protect her skin from the blistering sun? We're using different Vacation sunscreens, such as gel, spray on, stick, and even milk (ick). Who will WIN this sun screen test? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Why is Thrift Shopping SO Expensive Nowadays?
videos.overview: When you walk into a Goodwill, Savers, Salvation Army, or any other thrift store and expect to find t-shirts for $5 but you're met with a $40 price tag instead, you tend to get a bit upset. What's the deal with these HIGH thrift prices nowadays? It can't _just_ be inflation can it? There HAS to be more to this story. Today we get to the bottom of these outrageous thrift prices.

videos.title: I Tested EVERY Major Deodorant *they stink*
videos.overview: Are you stinky, loyal Theorist? Well, stink NO LONGER because we're here to find the BEST deodorant in today' challenge. We're testing deodorants like Dove, Lume, Old Spice, Native, and even some viral TikTok oddities against some of the most INTENSE challenges that would make anyone sweat. Will we still smell by the end of the day?

videos.title: Do Hair Growth Products ACTUALLY Work?
videos.overview: If you're losing hair on your head, then you're probably looking for a way to regrow your hair. Over the last 5-10 years, many products have taken on the market like Ro, Hims, Hers, and the classic Rogaine. But do hair growth products actually work? Can minoxidil give you a luscious mane again? Or is everything a bunch of bunk? Let's find out...

videos.title: I Tried Unusual Makeup Collabs *best and worst*
videos.overview: Would you trust makeup from McDonald's, Cheetos, Dunkin Donuts, or Chipotle? If you saw it in the beauty aisle at your local Target, the bright packaging would probably catch your eye. Maybe you'd try it out. But... is it actually any good? Today Amy is trying unusual beauty products to give you her honest review!

videos.title: I touched grass... and so should you!
videos.overview: Should you TOUCH GRASS? No, we're not insulting you. We literally are asking... should you TOUCH grass? Does going outside, pressing your palms against the luscious blades of grass, and sitting in nature actually have any benefits? Or should we all just stay inside forever?

videos.title: How to Clean White Sneakers... the RIGHT Way!
videos.overview: Picture this, loyal Theorist: you just spent your well-earned money on a brand new, sparkling clean, white pair of Nike Air Force 1s. You wear them out to show your friends, and then... you step in a puddle of mud. Yuck, gross! Now you have to clean them. So, what is the best way to do it?
